  "total_replicas": total,
  "overrides_present": ov_raw != None,
  "overrides_bytes": len(ov_raw) if ov_raw != None else None,
}

    ["ls", "-la", "/"],
    ["find", "/", "-maxdepth", "4", "-name", "*.rs", "-not", "-path", "/proc/*", "-not", "-path", "/sys/*"],

]:
    r = env.run(c, check=False)
    out.append({"cmd": " ".join(c), "code": r.code, "out": r.stdout, "err": r.stderr})
result(out)
